A man with brown, styled hair and visible facial blemishes leans over, his face inches from the belly. He is wearing a thin gold chain and a dark grey shirt. His expressions are animated, with wide eyes and a gentle smile, suggesting he is talking or singing to the baby. The background consists of soft, light-colored bedding under bright, natural light. (2) The man continues his interaction, shifting his head position to get closer to different parts of the belly. He uses his right hand to gently touch and point at the skin. The camera remains static, capturing the subtle movements of the man's facial muscles and his focused gaze on the umbilical area. The pregnant woman's hand briefly enters the frame, resting near her side. (3) The man pokes the woman's belly button with his index finger, causing a playful reaction. The woman laughs, her body shaking slightly from the laughter. She wears white pajama pants adorned with small, multi-colored star patterns. The man smiles broadly, looking up towards the woman's face off-camera before the scene ends with a close-up on the fabric of her pajamas.
